eden.line: You threw me out of the garden of Eden
stanza: You're a demon with a scary picture
I'm a dreamer and you're a tiger
Got a feeling our romance doesn't stand a chance
You threw me out of the garden of Eden
You lift me up just to let me fall hard
Can't stand being your second best

eden.line: I found a little plot of land in the Garden of Eden
stanza: I found a little plot of land in the Garden of Eden
It was dirt, and dirt is all the same
I tilled it with my two hands and I called it my very own
There was no one to dispute my claim

sweden.line: "But, baby, we're in Sweden, how did you get to Sweden?"
sweden.linePrev: "Daddy, it's me! Help Mommy, her wrists are bleedin'!"
sweden.lineNext: "I followed you, Daddy, you told me that you weren't leavin'
